description: A single-select segmented control — a linear strip of segments where exactly one is selected. The selected segment is brand-filled; the rest are secondary.

props.name: asChild
props.description:
When `true`, Root delegates rendering to a single consumer-supplied
element via the {@link Slot } pattern instead of the default `<div>`;
`role="radiogroup"`, `aria-orientation`, `data-orientation`,
`data-disabled`, `dir`, and remaining props are merged onto it.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description:
Value of the segment selected on first render. Omit for nothing
selected on mount.
Forbidden in controlled mode — use `value` instead.

props.name: dir
props.description:
Reading direction. In `"rtl"` the horizontal arrow pair is swapped so
Arrow Left moves forward. When omitted, it is inherited from the
nearest {@link DirectionProvider }, falling back to `"ltr"`.

props.name: disabled
props.description:
Disables the entire control — every segment is non-interactive and
excluded from arrow-key navigation, and `data-disabled=""` is set on
the root. Individual segments can also be disabled via the Item's own
`disabled` prop.

props.name: name
props.description:
Submit the selected value with the surrounding form under this name, as a
checked radio would: nothing while no segment is selected or the control is disabled. Optional:
without it the control takes no part in forms.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description:
Called with the new value whenever the selection changes. Optional
in uncontrolled mode.
Called with the new value whenever the selection changes. Required
in controlled mode.

props.name: orientation
props.description:
Which arrow-key pair moves focus and selection through the segments,
and the visual axis. `"horizontal"` binds Arrow Left/Right;
`"vertical"` binds Arrow Up/Down. Reflected as `aria-orientation` and
`data-orientation` on the root.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).
Forwarded to the underlying `HTMLDivElement`.

props.name: value
props.description:
Forbidden in uncontrolled mode — use `defaultValue` instead.
The currently selected value. Must be kept in sync by the parent
via `onValueChange`.

contractProps.name: size
contractProps.description: Control size for the whole control; `data-density` scales each size further.

contractProps.name: justify
contractProps.description: Whether segments share the track width equally or size to their content.

props.name: value
props.description:
Uniquely identifies this segment within the control and is reported to
`onValueChange` / matched against Root's `value` when selected. Required.

props.name: asChild
props.description:
When `true`, renders the single child element via the {@link Slot }
pattern instead of the default `<button>`; ARIA, `data-state`,
`data-disabled`, `tabIndex`, `disabled`, and `ref` are merged onto it,
and clicks and arrow keys on it are handled by the root's shared
controller. A non-focusable child must be made focusable by the consumer.

props.name: children
props.description: The segment's visible content — typically its text label.

props.name: disabled
props.description:
Disables just this segment: forwards the native `disabled` attribute,
removes it from arrow-key navigation and the roving-tabindex home base,
and sets `data-disabled=""`. The whole control can also be disabled via
Root's `disabled` prop.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).
Forwarded to the underlying `HTMLButtonElement`.

api.description:
`<primitiv-segmented-control>` — the state owner of a segmented control: a linear strip of segments of which exactly one is selected.

The root is a radio group: it takes `role="radiogroup"`, so name it with `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`, and each segment's `<button>` takes `role="radio"`. Only the selected segment is in the page's Tab order — the first enabled one while none is selected — and the arrow keys move focus and selection together, wrapping at the ends and skipping disabled segments. A selected segment never lets go: clicking it again changes nothing. The root reconciles its segments' ARIA whenever a segment arrives, leaves, or changes an attribute the root reads (the lifecycle is `PrimitivRootElement`'s).

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The selected segment's value. Reflected: it changes as the user selects, so a server re-render or a history snapshot sees the live selection. Omit it for nothing selected.

attributes.name: orientation
attributes.description: Layout axis, which picks the arrow-key pair. Defaults to `horizontal`.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Submit the selected value with a form, under this name, as a checked radio would: nothing while none is selected or the control is disabled. A form reset restores the value the control first rendered with. Without it the control takes no part in forms.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disables the whole control: every segment is skipped by the arrow keys and never selected, and `data-disabled` is set on the root and every segment.

events.name: primitiv-segmented-control-change
events.description: Bubbles, cancelable, fired before a user-driven selection is applied, with the segment selected afterwards. Call `preventDefault()` to veto it.

api.description: `<primitiv-segmented-control-item>` — an interactive part: one segment. It decorates exactly one child the consumer writes, a `<button>`, which gets `role="radio"`, `aria-checked`, `data-state="checked" | "unchecked"` and the roving `tabindex`.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The segment's value, the root's `value` while it is selected.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Skipped by the arrow keys and never selected (`aria-disabled` and `data-disabled` on the child).
